days.title: BAGDOGRA AIRPORT / NJP RAILWAY STATION TO DARJEELING
days.body: Meet & Greet on arrival at Bagdogra Airport / NJP Railway Station & transfer to Darjeeling. Darjeeling is the Queen of Hills. On arrival Check-in to hotel & rest of the day at leisure. Overnight stay at Darjeeling.

days.title: DARJEELING SIGHTSEEING
days.body: Early Morning (at 04:00 am) drive to Tiger hill to watch the spectacular sunrise over Mt. Kanchendzonga (World’s 3rd highest peak), on your way back visit Ghoom Monastery and Batasia Loop. After breakfast visit Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, P.N. Zoological Park (Closed on Thursday ), Tenzing Rock, Tibetan Refugee self-help Centre (Sunday closed), Tea Garden (outer view), Ropeway and Japanese Temple (All depends on time). Back to hotel – Overnight stay at Darjeeling.

days.title: DARJEELING TO GANGTOK
days.body: This morning after breakfast transfer to Gangtok. Nearly 100 kilometres 3:30 hour’s drive – Gangtok is the Capital of Sikkim. On arrival check-in to your hotel. Overnight stay at. Gangtok.

days.title: GANGTOK LOCAL SIGHTSEEING
days.body: Morning Breakfast - Drive for visit Ranka Monastery, Botanical Garden, Ganesh Tok, Tashi View Point, Barthang waterfalls, Nam Nang view point, Ropeway, Flower Show, Directorate of Handicrafts & Handloom, Research Institute of Tibetology & Do Drul Chorten (Stupa) etc (All depends on time). – Back to hotel - Evening free to roam around M G Road (Mall) or local Shopping centre - Overnight stay at Gangtok.

days.title: EXCURSION TO TSOMGO LAKE & BABA MANDIR
days.body: Morning Breakfast - Excursion to Tsomgo Lake (commonly known as Changu Lake) & Baba Mandir nearly 40 kilometres and 2 hours drive - Situated at an elevation of 3753 meters / 12310 feet - The Lake is oval shaped lake nearly 50 feet deep - Generally covered in snow for most of the year the year – This lake is home to the Brahmini ducks & many migratory birds – Nearby is the sacred Baba Mandir known to be a very holy site for all (Optional visit to Nathula Pass at extra charge) – Back to Gangtok. Overnight stay at Gangtok.

days.title: GANGTOK TO NJP RAILWAY STATION / BAGDOGRA AIRPORT
days.body: After breakfast Check-out from hotel and take the departure transfers to NJP Railway Station / Bagdogra Airport for your onward journey.
